title: A Aftermath for the Inventory
author: Elodie Galloway
blurb: Coral Reyes, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
